messages:
nisha_sec: Heads-up: third-party penetration test next Thursday 08:30-12:30 PT. We need a compact runbook: RBAC snapshot, KMS-safe upload path, evidence manifest, and retest gating. Can we outline minimal permissions and the verification steps?

dan_ops: I'll own the upload path. Prefer presigned POST with bucket default-encryption (kms CMK) and deny kms:GenerateDataKey or decrypt for the assessor principal. That keeps keys ops-only.

dan_ops: We'll create a staging-only bucket `redwood-pt-staging` and lifecycle rule to expire after 45 days. Multipart uploads required for >100MB.

maria_platform: For RBAC snapshot: export STS & IAM policies as of timestamp with a short script and store alongside evidence. `aws iam list-roles` + `get-role-policy` dump to JSON + sha256sum. Put manifest in `manifests/`.

sam_sre: For temporary roles, use our sts-mint endpoint that issues creds scoped to S3:PutObject and ListBucket on the specific prefix only. No kms perms in the policy. We'll also tag those creds with `pt_id=<id>` so traces show up in CloudTrail.

irina_devsec: Quick note: presigned PUTs for SSE-KMS require the requestor to have KMS:Encrypt if the kms key ID is in the request. To avoid that, configure the bucket to use default encryption key so PUTs don't include kms headers. That means uploads are encrypted without giving assesors KMS rights.

josh_cs: Can we give the assessors a sample curl + multipart example? They asked for it. Also a short allowable filetype list (tgz, zip, json, pcap) and max single-object 8GB.

dan_ops: I'll post curl examples in staging once role is created. Example: `curl -F "key=pt-2026/assessor1/20260316_1234.tgz" -F "file=@report.tgz" https://redwood-pt-presign.example.com/` where our presign gateway mints the POST fields.

maria_platform: Audit export plan: run cloudtrail lookup + saas-app logs + systemd journal for hosts in scope. Bundle to a gzipped tarball, add SHA256 manifest and the RBAC JSON. Command snippet: `tar -czf pt-2026-03-archive.tgz cloudtrail.json host-journal.log iam-snapshot.json && sha256sum pt-2026-03-archive.tgz > pt-2026-03-archive.tgz.sha256`

sam_sre: Retest policy proposal: critical -> emergency retest (48h), high -> 72h mitigation window then retest, medium/low -> 7-14 days depending on backlog. All retests require a short verification plan in PR with CI evidence (unit/integration tests or config changes) and a smoke endpoint test that SRE runs before scheduling.

irina_devsec: Triage matrix I'll post: severity -> mandatory evidence (patch PR link, infra change diff, logs showing false positive, exploit PoC fixed), owner mapping. Also add a CVE lookback: are any vulns related to known CVEs? If yes, mark for expedited track.

josh_cs: Also need a customer-facing summary template so we can communicate remediation ETA and residual risk. Short bullets + mitigation steps + contact.

security-bot: Created task SEC-2026-1220 "PT upload path + RBAC snapshot + retest rules" (assignee: dan_ops; due: 2026-03-19).

dan_ops: Action list: 1) provision pt-bucket with default-KMS and lifecycle 45d, 2) add presign gateway endpoints for POST and multipart, 3) sample curl/JS SDK snippets. ETA EOD Wednesday staging preview.

maria_platform: I'll add the audit-export script to the ticket and include exact time ranges we should capture (+24h pre and +24h post test).

irina_devsec: I'll draft the triage and retest matrix and include example PR checklist items to verify fixes.

nisha_sec: Let's run a 20-min dry run (STS mint + upload) the day before the engagement. If staging works, we'll flip prod paths. No objections?

josh_cs: Sounds good; I'll confirm assessor availability for dry run.

nisha_sec: Great. If anyone hits blockers, tag me and I'll escalate.
